definitions.explanation: The act of collecting money owed, especially debts. Can imply aggressive or persistent collection efforts.

definitions.gloss: freshly picked; freshly made; just harvested
definitions.explanation: Describes something that has just been picked, caught, or made. Emphasizes freshness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{立|た}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{取|と}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧くる。
{闇金|やみきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{立|た}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people are troubled by collection from loan sharks.

examples.english: Tomatoes freshly picked in the morning have a different aroma.

notes:
Has two distinct meanings that are easily distinguished by context. Sense 1 (debt collection) appears in financial and legal contexts, while sense 2 (freshness) appears with food and agricultural products.

SENSE 1 — COLLECTION:
- {取|と}り{立|た}て⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: debt collector
- {取|と}り{立|た}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: the collector comes
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{取|と}り{立|た}て: harsh collection

SENSE 2 — FRESHNESS:
Used as a modifier before nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {取|と}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧, {取|と}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧. This sense is always positive, emphasizing just-harvested quality.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: recovery, collection — more formal, broader usage
- ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧: fresh — describes the quality itself, not the act of harvesting
- {採|と}れたて: freshly harvested — similar to sense 2 but more casual

FORMS:
{取|と}り{立|た}てる (to collect; to appoint) → {取|と}り{立|た}て (noun form)
